name: Thaumaturgical Rituals — 3 Advanced — Bone of Contention

system.description: Prepared like a Bone of Lies from a century-old fingerbone steeped in blood, a Bone of Contention instead forces its holder to speak whatever lie you, its creator, will — so long as you can see the bone — rather than compelling the truth. In your absence it behaves exactly like an ordinary Bone of Lies. Like its counterpart, it is exhausted after ten uses.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
